name: techpulse-blog
description: Blog tech MVC : avis, likes et classement d'articles (Express + EJS + SQLite)

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process');const f=cp.execSync('find . -name \"*.js\" -not -path \"./node_modules/*\"').toString().trim().split('\n');let e=0;for(const x of f){try{new Function(fs.readFileSync(x,'utf8'))}catch(err){console.error('FAIL',x,err.message);e=1}}if(!e)console.log('syntax OK ('+f.length+' files)');process.exit(e)"
